stem: How did southern states respond to the ratification of the Fifteenth Amendment?

options.label: A
options.text: By creating a segregated public education system

options.label: B
options.text: By shutting down all remaining offices of Freedmen’s Bureau

options.label: C
options.text: By imposing requirements designed to deny African Americans the right to vote

options.label: D
options.text: By forcing African Americans to work as tenant farmers and sharecroppers
